name: Naga
traitOneDesc:
Nagas' unique form leaves them well adapted for grappling.
When you have a target grappled, your hands are still free.
You have a +3 bonus to saves against being grappled or restrained, and to checks to escape them.
traitTwoDesc:
Nagas' sharp claws make for good weapons in a pinch.
Unarmed Attack.
Deals 1d4 slashing damage. (Finesse, Agile).
traitThreeDesc:
Nagas are one of the most magically inclined species and most nagas pick up at least some spells.
Learn two Apprentice-level spells.
traitFourDesc:
Nagas are slightly slower than most, but can move in bursts of motion that make them hard to track.
You have 4 tiles Land Speed.
You can Step 2 tiles, or 1 tile onto difficult terrain.

name: Yirte
traitOneDesc:
Yirtes live in the forests and jungles, and are used to climbing the trees of their homeland.
4 tiles climbing speed.
traitTwoDesc:
While they may be small in size, yirte are fierce and ready to defend themselves by claw if need be.
Unarmed Attack.
Deals 1d4 slashing damage. (Finesse, Agile).
traitThreeDesc:
Yirte are fast runners and decent climbers.
6 Tiles Land Speed.
traitFourDesc:
Yirte can easily camouflage themselves in the forests they live in.
You have a +3 bonus to Stealth checks when hiding among foliage and plant life.

name: Gnome
traitOneDesc:
Gnomes' natural connection to magic allows them to absorb magical effects.
You have the Absorb Magic reaction
traitTwoDesc:
Gnomes have impressive memories and can easily remember facts and figures.
You become trained in one Intelligence skill of your choice.
You can change it on level up.
traitThreeDesc:
Gnomes are known for their artifice, and generally have some kind of crafting project in construction at all times.
You have one level 1 Gadget.
If stolen or destroyed you can make a new one with an hour's downtime.

name: Vesper
traitOneDesc:
Vespers are the only sapient humanoid species that can fly, though their fighting abilities are limited while they do.
You have 4 tiles flying speed, which cannot be used while wearing heavy armor or encumbered.
You cannot use two-handed weapons while flying.
You take a -3 penalty all attacks or spellshaping checks while flying.
traitTwoDesc:
Having lived for long in the dark caves, vespers see well in darker environments.
You have low-light vision.
traitThreeDesc:
While not true echolocation, vespers' ears are sensitive, though this makes loud noises dangerous.
You have a +3 bonus on Perception checks relying on hearing.
You take a -3 penalty on saves against effects that deal thunder damage or inflict the Deafened condition.
traitFourDesc:
Vespers' lightweight bones make them bad brawlers and leave them struggling in heavy winds.
You count as one size smaller when it comes to grappling.
You take a -3 penalty on saves against wind effects while flying.

name: Human
traitOneDesc:
Humans are enduring, pressing beyond their limits.
The first time you would become fatigued each day, ignore it.
traitTwoDesc:
Humans are driven and work hard to pick up new skills.
Gain one more level 1 General Feat.

name: Dragonkin
traitOneDesc:
Dragonkin can use their powerful tail to stand firm against blows that would move them.
You have the Steady by Tail reaction.
traitTwoDesc:
Dragonkin have sharper claws, though perhaps with less finesse.
Unarmed Attack. 
Deals 1d6 slashing damage. (Agile).
traitThreeDesc:
Dragonkin scales are tough and many have been saved by a blow glancing off a scale.
You have a +1 bonus to Reflex and Fortitude saving throws.
traitFourDesc:
Once per hour you can add a 1d4 to a d20 roll.
If you critically fail on this roll you become Frightened 1.

name: Aruna
traitOneDesc:
Aruna wings cannot provide true flight, but they can glide from place to place.
You have a 6 tiles Glide speed when not restrained.
When falling, you can use a reaction to spread your wingarms, preventing any fall damage.
traitTwoDesc:
Aruna possess sharp talons and know how to fight with them.
Unarmed Attack.
Deals 1d4 slashing damage. (Finesse, Agile).
traitThreeDesc:
You have 4 tiles Swim Speed.
You can hold your breath for 1 minute, plus a number of rounds equal to twice your PHY.

name: Troll
traitOneDesc:
Trolls have a natural regeneration that they can channel to recover.
You can spend a minute to regenerate 1d8 health.
Twice per long rest.
traitTwoDesc:
The tough hide of trolls allows them to shrug off damage.
You have resistance 2 to physical damage.
traitThreeDesc:
Whenever you force a creature 8 or more tiles away to make a Reflex or Fortitude saving throw, they have a +2 bonus to the save.
You take a -3 penalty on visual Perception checks targeting things beyond 8 tiles.

name: Brannur
traitOneDesc:
Brannur are strong and tough.
You have a +2 bonus to Athletics checks to carry and break things.
traitTwoDesc:
The red eyes of brannur allow them to see in the dark. It has scared many foes.
You have low-light vision.
You can make visual Intimidation checks without penalties.
traitThreeDesc:
Brannur can resist things that might put most down.
Once per day you may choose to reroll a saving throw.
You must keep the new result, even if it's worse.
